description: Select a project you own by id or slug for the active session. Set remap=true together with confirm=true to change the current folder mapping (papi_dir) on local stdio. Use when "switch to golf" / "point papi at <project>". Fails closed if the project is not on your account. No Anthropic API.

confirm.description: Required when remap=true because it changes the repository-to-project mapping.

project.description: The project id (UUID) or slug to switch to.

remap.description: When true, request changing the current folder mapping as well as the session default. Requires confirm=true.

name: project_switch
